source: Real transactions for the types that belong to a whole tx, not to one output. Each raw tx was read from WhatsOnChain (GET /v1/bsv/main/tx/<txid>/hex) and hashes to its txid. A type lists the vectors it is tested against under tx_vectors; height and block_time are the block it was mined in; expected says whether the classifier gives the tx that type.

vectors.name: tx_nlocktime_typed
vectors.description: Lock time 415,833 with its one input's sequence at 0xfffffffe, mined in block 420,000: 4,167 blocks (about four weeks) below its block, so signed long before it was mined, not the anti-fee-sniping shape

vectors.name: tx_nlocktime_anti_fee_sniping
vectors.description: Lock time 399,988 with its one input's sequence at 0xfffffffe, mined in block 400,000: the lock binds, but 12 blocks below the block it was mined in, the anti-fee-sniping shape Bitcoin Core gave every payment, so it is not the type

vectors.name: tx_nlocktime_ignored
vectors.description: Lock time 973,899 (a height) with every input's sequence final at 0xffffffff, so the rules ignore it
